description: Verify that DUT receives a TCP packet with the URG flag set and replies with an ACK whose ack_num is the expected value (RFC 4413 §4.2.4)
approach:
[Objective]
The URG flag does not change ACK semantics — DUT must still acknowledge the data normally. Urgent processing happens above TCP; the ack_num must cover all received bytes.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment with URG=1 + payload.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK with ack_num covering the urgent payload.

[Pass condition]
DUT acks the URG segment with the correct ack_num.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_urg_ack — DUT did not ack URG segment
• Fail_wrong_ack_num — ACK does not cover URG payload

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked URG-flagged data with correct ack_num — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_urg_ack: No DUT ACK to URG segment
verdicts.Fail_wrong_ack_num: DUT ack_num does not acknowledge URG payload
